svg.title: A contractor's repeated exception stamps cover nearly every invoice.
svg.desc: A large pile of procurement invoices shares the same blank override-stamp position, while only two ordinary invoices lack it. Vale reports thirty-one exceptions and Cecil notes that the ordinary invoices have become unusual.
svg.text: Page 48, panel 3 · Top-down view of procurement invoices beside the useful traces

text.tspan: The audit exposes a manual override pattern
